title: Hold a licence to sell smoking products
what: Sell smoking products only under a retail (or wholesale) licence.

laws.title: Tobacco and Other Smoking Products Act 1998 (Qld)

sources.title: Tobacco and Other Smoking Products Act 1998 (Qld)
sources.quote: A supplier must not sell a smoking product unless the supplier holds a retail or wholesale licence that authorises that type of sale

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Tobacco and Other Smoking Products Act 1998 (Qld)

sources.quote: the chief executive must grant an application for a retail licence (liquor) if the applicant is the liquor licensee for the liquor licensed premises at which smoking products are proposed to be sold.
